text: Forethought AI agents by Zendesk are self-improving AI agents that can understand customer requests, take action and continuously improve outcomes over time. These agents bring specialised AI into the Zendesk AI ecosystem and can handle more complex workflows across all channels and environments. They’re built to work seamlessly within Zendesk for those looking to elevate their service experience – and, just as importantly, they work on any platform, making it easy to bring best-in-class AI agents to an existing stack. Contact Sales to learn more.
